code:
Reward collapses mid-training  -> lr/clip_range too large, check approx_kl spike
Reward frozen, no progress     -> clip_fraction ~0, lr too small or dead advantages
Entropy crashes early          -> raise entropy coef c2, check advantage sign
explained_variance stuck ~0    -> critic not learning; check GAE wiring, gamma/lambda
